title: Hearty Fried Italian Eggplant Pasta
description: A cultured and pillowy date-night Italian dish featuring cayenne pepper, this shojin-friendly recipe is sure to impress, with a delightful combination of fried eggplant and pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced eggplant to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the eggplant from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with any remaining oil and eggplant bits.
Add the cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce, tossing to combine.
Add the fried eggplant to the pasta and sauce, and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta and eggplant to a serving dish and top with mozzarella and parmesan cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
